''See also: [[Naru Gwei Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Naru]] Gwei is the Captain of the [[Skysworn]] and holds the title of [[Underlord]]. Serving the [[Blackflame Empire]], he acts as an adjudicator and upholder of imperial law. He possesses large emerald wings and utilizes [[spiritual perception]] to navigate the world, as he does not belong to the [[Arelius bloodline]]. His appearance is characterized by matted or dirty gray hair, facial burn scars resulting from a [[Blackflame]] injury, and a tendency to chew on leaves. He carries a massive dark [[sword]] and wears green armor or a battered breastplate. In his official capacity, he conducts inspections of various sects and evaluates their rankings, such as the [[Twin Star Sect]]. He operates from a [[cloudship]] and maintains a residence in [[Starsweep Tower]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Naru]] Gwei has filthy gray hair and facial burn scars, including a mark over his eye. He wears old, battered green armor and possesses two enormous emerald wings that serve as his [[Goldsign]]. He also carries a dark gray [[sword]] featuring a long, thick, and notched blade.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As an [[Underlord]] and Captain of the [[Skysworn]], he carries out arrests under the Authority{{!}}authority of the emperor and the [[Blackflame Empire]]. He is responsible for designing [[Stormrock]]'s location near Serpent's Grave{{!}}Serpent’s Grave.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|He possesses the ability to fly using his emerald wings and can control Wind aura{{!}}wind aura. He also emits a green nebulous [[madra]].}}
